description: Live crypto news headlines aggregated by three.ws directly from 197 publisher RSS/Atom feeds, CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt, CoinTelegraph, SEC press, exchange blogs, research desks, and international outlets in 17 languages. Filter by category (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, defi, nft, trading, research, security, regulation-adjacent geopolitical, and more), by a single source key, by language, or full-text search the headlines. Each article returns title, publisher link, source, publish time, detected tickers, and lexicon sentiment. An invalid category/source errors with the valid list, so retry from that. For the day grouped into stories use crypto_news_digest; for coverage older than a few days use crypto_news_archive. Free — no payment or API key required.

category.description: One category slug, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, defi, nft, trading, research, onchain, security, mainstream, geopolitical, journalism. Omit for all. Invalid values error with the full list.

lang.description: Language code: en (default), or any of the 17 registry languages (zh, ja, ko, es, de, fr, …), or "all" to interleave every language.

q.description: Full-text filter over title/description/tickers, e.g. "bitcoin etf" or "SOL".

source.description: A single source key (e.g. coindesk, theblock, sec_press) — overrides category and lang.

name: crypto_news
title: Crypto news (live, 197 feeds)
